content: Pol-me Philemon piri pepa tua rapaasa
Ni Pol-re Yesu Krais-na kogono madaa kalabus ada-para pi. Niaana ame Timoti saa laapome go pepa Philemon ne re-para o taatepa. Nere ora ni raapu kogono padane-rupa pepa.
Niaana baani Apia su-para niaana kogono yago aa Akipaa-para go pepa o taatepa. Go page nena ada-para lotu kiritalo pimi onaanu-para page go pepa o taatepa.
Niaana Aapa Gote-para niaana Aa Mudu Yesu Krais lapome nipuna epe raba meape agaa-para kuma pi kone-para nimina pu robaa-para mea gina.
Philemon-me Aa Mudu kone rulasa
Nina ame Philemon nere oro yaalo neme beten to rabu nena bi loa Gote-para ora pi to.
Gore nemere Gote-na ruru onaa madaa pedo pu raaname omoa Aa Mudu Yesu madaa kone waru rulaaye-daa remaa pagoaayo.
Gore niaa nimi kone rulaeme onaanu raapu kone padane-rupa samina. Goa pua niaa Yesu raapu pirua nipuna puri rayo adaminalo beten to.

Gore epe ame aa waru paga. Nena pedo pu raana omape konere ora epe ta konemere naa robaa-para raana omape kone masaawa puri ora mapalaaya. Gore neme kone gupa suaaye rabu Gote-na ruru onaanuna robaa-para epe kone masaaye.
Philemon-me Onesimus-ri nipuna ame-rupa lamu misa
Goa pua saa Krais-na ame pipa-pulu neme oyae meda paina kone i. Goa pua neme go konere agaa mana-rupa lagialo.
Neme ne madaa pedo pu raana omalo-ga neme agaa pawa meape. Gore ni Yesu Krais-na agaa lakene aa ya-pulu ni kalabus ada-para pi. Goa pea pare puri pane agaa nalagialua.
Dia, pare neme Krais-na pora pamuae kone isa-daa Onesimus
madaa agaa tepa kone i. Neme kalabus pirua neme nipu naa si-rupa kone rulape kone mogeaaya-pulu niri Krais-na Aapa pi.
Abade nipumiri ne raapu pirua epe kogono napisade. Goa pisade pare abiare nipumi saa laapo rata raba meape kogono pala.
Abia nipu wala ne piri mea repaato. Goa pi rabu nina robaa-para kone nipu mada pira palae epalia.
Neme epe agaa moge riape kogono madaa kalabus ada piruaayo-pulu neme Onesimus ni raapu pirua ni raba mina kone sawa. Goa pua nena alo-para nipu pirita penalo.
Goa pea pare neme go madaa e natedaare gore neme nipu nasaapitua. Dia, pare nena koneme nipu epenala kone sali-daare neme nipu mada mea rapalua.
Gore nipumi abade ne ogesi gimisade pare abiare wala nipu oro yaalo ne raapu piralipina.

Goa puare abia nipuri pa kogonome adini naaki-rupadaa napia. Dia, pare abiare nipu ora niaana Krais-na ame ya-pulu nipu madaa pa kogono adini aa pia-daa natema. Gore neme page nipu ora nina ame ya-pulu raaname omalo. Goa pea-ga neme nipu mealiri nipu kogono adini naaki epe-rupa piralia. Goa pea pare nipu Aa Mudu raapu pirua ora nena ame ya-pulu neme nipu madaa raana ora waru omape.
Goa pua neme saa Krais-na kogono padane pepa kone sali-daare gore ni mulalo agaa lage-rupa Onesimus page go-rupa waru mogeawa meape.
Goa pea pare nipumi abade ne madaa waea meda palo pisa-daare ni madaa yago ma-ape. Goa pua nipumi rudu meda mealo pisa-daare gore ni madaa yago ma-ape.
Niri Pol go agaare ora nina kimi talo: Go yanore nina bipa abutua. Gore ora nena epe-rupa pirape kone madaare nere ni madaa yago ia-ga akeane neme go madaa agaa lano ya?
Gore nina ame Aa Mudu-na bi madaare go epe raana pi kogono pape. Ne saa laapore Krais-na ame lapo pipa-ga go kone madaare neme naa robaa-para epe kone masaape.
Neme go pepa epenalalore go agaa ratua piraina kone sua pi. Gore neme mo pape lalo yaenu rayo-para medaloma page mada pali kone salo.
Goa pea pare ne agaa meda pa lagialo: Neme nina ada pada meda managola sape. Gore neme kone salo pare Gote-me nimina beten pagalia rabu niri wala nimi raapu madaa mapiraalia kone salo.
Agaa medaloma lakesa
Epafras-re ni raapu Yesu Krais-na kogono madaa kalabus ada-para piruaaepa. Go aamere ne epe-rupa pirapelo wai lo o taata.
Nina kogono padane-para pi aanu Mak-para Aristarkus-para Demas-para Luk-para nimumi page ne-para epe-rupa pirapelo wai lo o taateme.
Abiare Aa Mudu Yesu Krais-me nipuna raba meape kone kuma pi nimina robaa-para mea repaaina. Goa pua nimi raapu ina. Go mada. Ni Pol yaade.

footnotes.text: 1.10 Onesimus-ri Filimon-na kogonome adini aa yapare nipu pogola pua Pol raapu pisa. Goa puare nipu Kristen aa-rupa pua pirisa. Juda onaana rekena agaare go-rupa. Kogonome adini aa medaa gupa pogola palia-daare surube aame yada pi aanu lakeloa repena polopea madaa nilimi tala pisimi.
